commands.name: 1. Deploy wizard
commands.description: Select + flags, danger confirm (production), progress, done with actions.

commands.name: 1b. Deploy wizard (kai kip helper)
commands.description: The same wizard as command 1, written with the `kai kip` helper instead of hand-written JSON. Needs the kai binary reachable from where the script runs.

commands.name: 2. Database restore
commands.description: Table field, destructive confirm with Back, steps checklist.

commands.name: 3. Cluster navigator
commands.description: Cascading fields: changing the context updates the namespace and pod lists.

commands.name: 4. Scaffold a project
commands.description: Text, list, folder picker and flags; try an invalid name (e.g. 'My App') for the round trip.

commands.name: 5. Team onboarding (own window)
commands.description: Live checklist, notification and a warning result. Opens in its own window.

commands.name: 6. Sign in (exports a token)
commands.description: Secret field. Password: kai. Exports KAI_DEMO_TOKEN; then run command 7.

commands.name: 7. Show the token (plain command)
commands.description: Not KIP: prints the token that command 6 exported.

commands.name: 8. Convert a file
commands.description: File picker, options, progress, reveal the output.

commands.name: 9. Customer lookup
commands.description: Query, result table (select a cell, Ctrl+C), copy action.

commands.name: 10. Raw protocol (minimal)
commands.description: The smallest KIP program: JSON lines printed by hand, no functions at all; see the script.

commands.name: 11. Not a KIP program
commands.description: Marked as KIP but the program doesn't speak it: Kai shows the 'doesn't support KIP' screen.

commands.name: 12. Branch picker with chips (quiver-style)
commands.description: Paged, filterable list plus chips (ctx / sync / PR / delete): small buttons that run an ephemeral action and show the result in a box. Demo data only.

commands.name: 13. Python KIP (no file, `import kip`)
commands.description: The command text IS the program: Kai injects the kip module, so a wizard is a few lines.

commands.name: 14. Node KIP (global `kip`, top-level await)
commands.description: Same wizard in Node: the global kip, promises and top-level await.
